reviews.author: Kim Coner
reviews.text:
One of my bucket list items was to buy handmade shoes that fit my feet perfectly.  While looking for the best handmade shoe store in Korea, I chose Songlim Shoes, which boasts a long history, but when I tried to implement it, I couldn't move forward, so I hesitated and finally took the step.  I got handmade shoes, one of my bucket list items, here at Songlim Handmade Shoes. The handmade shoes I wanted to order were regal-style men's shoes with hiking shoe soles, but on my first visit, a person who seemed to be the son of the owner of Songlim Handmade Shoes, a company with a long tradition, looked at my unusual feet and advised me that such shoes would not fit well. This appears to be because the instep is high and the width of the foot is large due to genetic influences. I had no choice but to choose Tyrolean shoes as my second choice. I made a 3D model of the sole, carefully measured the height and width of the instep, paid a deposit, and received a Gabon date.
It's not even a suit, it's Gabon? It feels like there is more trust.
Finally, on the Gabon day that coincided with my business trip to Seoul, surprisingly, there was an owner who proved the history and did the Gabon himself.
My original goal was to use Regal men's shoes with hiking boot soles, but I was sad that I gave up after listening to my son's advice. However, I was encouraged by the fact that I could fit my feet to an approximate size, even if it was not the sharp shape of the Regal itself.
I thought that if the Tyrolean shoes fit well, next time I will match the Regal men's shoes with hiking boot soles.
After receiving the handmade shoes by courier and trying them on, they felt good.

reviews.author: Yeunsug Park
reviews.text: I've been living a hard life for the past 10 years that I can't express in words. By coincidence, I heard that Songlim Shoes was also making special shoes. I told them about my situation by email and told them that I couldn't go to Korea because they were tired. So I asked for some shoes (I live in New York) in the hopes of saving someone's life. And this winter, I got some shoes for me, and I'm still wearing them. In fact, I have serious flat feet. I have been suffering from bad cramps in my legs, and for several years now I have been suffering from knee pain for no apparent reason. I have tried every day. I tried everything. Especially, I went to the hospital and tried on very expensive insoles, homemade shoes, and expensive air-filled Nike sneakers, but it didn't help. But it was strange. I couldn't believe it either. Haha. Two weeks ago, even walking for more than 30 minutes made me scared. That's how much knee pain I had. So, while I was at it, I ordered another one. I thought there were people suffering like me, so don't take it easy. When I was young, I didn't know either. In fact, I started wearing insoles about 15 years ago when flat feet were unheard of and the cause of the disease in Korea. The doctor said that it would be comfortable to wear them, but there was no explanation or simple exercises to prevent flat feet from getting worse. But when I came here, American doctors were a little bit different. I went there thinking it would be different, but this place wasn't much different. So, although I'm a little late, I'm working out hard and walking with the right posture. Try them out at least once before it's too late. Actually, I have a lot to say, and I'll talk about them after trying on the shoes they make for the second time.

reviews.author: 浩生莊
reviews.text:
Best convenience store in Korea: Myeongdong 7-Eleven Ramen Library

It would be a real shame if you didn't stop by a convenience store for a late-night snack during your trip to Korea! In particular, this 7-Eleven near the Myeongdong hotel is a dream paradise for ramen lovers.

🥢 Colorful ramen wall and Espa icon

When you enter the store, you will be surprised to see an entire wall filled with ramen! From classic Shin Ramyun to Neoguri Ramen, to various regional limited edition ramen, there is everything.

• A must-take photo zone for Espa fans: There are eye-catching Espa billboards all over the walls, so after purchasing ramen, take a photo with the goddesses.

• Themed seating: The dining area in the photo is decorated in a cute way, complete with a cute raccoon mascot so that you can have fun while eating ramen. This place is bright and clean and has a completely different atmosphere from typical convenience stores.

👨‍🍳 Main character in Korean drama: Unmanned automatic ramen cooker

Be sure to experience the **"Automatic Ramen Cooker"** in the photo! This is a secret weapon that the main characters of Korean dramas use when eating ramen on the banks of the Han River.

1. Ramen selection: When paying, the staff will give you a special container of ramen.

2. One-touch cooking: Put the noodles and seasoning in the container, place it on the machine, and press just one button to automatically fill the container with water, heat it, and start the timer.

3. Perfect taste: In just a few minutes, you'll have a bowl of authentic Korean ramen with chewy noodles and hot broth!

🛍️ Take care of your health as well as ramen

In addition to food, this convenience store also has a variety of other products on display to enrich your experience. In the photo, I'mvita vitamin supplements and various health foods are on display. Soothe your tired body with some shopping and recharge your energy before heading back to the hotel. That way, you can continue shopping with energy the next day!

💡 Tip: Specialty convenience stores in Myeongdong are usually crowded, so if you want to enjoy noodle dishes in a more leisurely manner, it is best to avoid the evening hours.

reviews.author: Karen Graham
reviews.text:
7-Eleven offers unique fun through its self-service ramen corner. You can choose from a variety of ramen, take out toppings and a boiled egg from the refrigerator, pay at the counter, and the ramen will be cooked right away for you. Toppings, noodles, and eggs are 5,000 won each.
Clear English instructions make cooking simple, and the entire process takes about 3 minutes. The store is clean and beautifully decorated, offering a unique and enjoyable experience typical of Korean convenience stores.

I bought a small card, a bottle of milk tea, and a bottle of water, but the receipt showed that it was two cards and two bottles of milk tea.
When I asked, “Why did it count as two?” the staff member said, “The milk tea was a buy-one-get-one deal, so I scanned it twice.”
There were no notices about the event anywhere, and I only took one bottle.
The clerk didn't say anything, perhaps thinking I wouldn't notice, without even mentioning that I had to pick up the second bottle myself.
“Please remove your card and order again,” I said, and only then did they pay the bill properly.
They wouldn't even give me a receipt until I asked for it.
Then he started talking nonsense like, “If I know how to speak Chinese, people would ask me to cook instant ramen and eat it?” But I couldn’t understand what he was saying because I didn’t even buy ramen.
When you get here, be sure to check the screen, ask for a receipt, and don't leave until everything is properly accounted for.

reviews.author: 侑成果蔡正男
reviews.text:
Enjoy breakfast at a Korean CU convenience store!

When you're wondering what to have for breakfast in Korea, convenience stores are always the best choice. This time I went to the CU flagship store in Myeongdong. It was really unique to see three ramen corners set up behind glass partitions before even entering the entrance. There are many people who eat ramen instead of rice balls.

There were many different types of ramen, both cup ramen and ramen.

Cup ramen can be easily boiled as hot water is provided, and ramen can be purchased in a special container and boiled using a ramen machine at a convenience store, making it an even more special breakfast.

You can choose as many toppings as you want. We added crab meat and sausage and enjoyed a hearty and delicious breakfast.

If you're in Korea and don't know what to eat for breakfast, instant ramen from CU convenience stores is a good option.

#Korean Breakfast #CU Convenience Store #Korean Instant Ramen #Myeongdong Restaurant #Convenience Store Food #Korea Travel #Korea Travel

There were three round tables made of ramen, and my wish to come here for breakfast someday came true today! I have also seen many Taiwanese customers choosing specific menu items. There are many different types of ramen, and even if it is not cup ramen, you can also heat and eat ramen directly from a plastic container. Special containers can be purchased at the counter.
